thread_text:
anna-peopleops: Quick drop 1 a tiny 'Goal Clarity Blurb' managers and ICs can paste into 1:1s or self-reviews. Super short, actionable.

leo-engineer: Love it. Make it explicit how to spot drift (one sentence).

maya-hrbp: Add a field "evidence (link or 2 bullets)" so calibrators have receipts.

anna-peopleops: Draft below 1 copyable. Keep to 5 lines so people actually fill it.

---
`Goal Clarity Blurb (copyable)`
- Goal (1 line): [what you will deliver + owner + due]
- Success signal (1 line): [metric / baseline -> target]
- On-track check (1 line): [what healthy progress looks like; e.g., weekly drop in p95 by X ms]
- Risk / blocker (1 line): [top risk and who can help]
- Evidence (1 link or 2 bullets with dates): [date  short fact / PR / ticket]

`Manager micro-phrases`
- Praise: "Nice work  that metric movement is clear and tied to user impact."
- Redirect: "I see the risk X surfaced  let's pick one mitigation this week and revisit."
---

ben-manager: This is perfect for our weekly sync. Can we add a note: "timebox to 10 minutes"?

anna-peopleops: Added in the playbook: timebox 10 minutes; if more, schedule a follow-up. I'll also add a template to Notion and a Slack snippet.

leo-engineer: Thanks  will paste before my 1:1.

notify-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Publish Goal Clarity Blurb to Manager Playbook" on 2026-04-05 09:00 UTC

maya-hrbp: Looks good  recommend managers paste the short evidence into calibration folder 7 days before window opens.

anna-peopleops: Noted  will add automated calendar ping for managers.

ben-manager: Nice and usable. Thanks everyone!
